title: Lord of the Flies
author: William Golding
engineRationale: William Golding's 1954 classic is a pure allegorical study of institutional collapse, fear, and human nature. The narrative centers on universal psychological archetypes—the democratic leader (Ralph), the rationalist (Piggy), the demagogue (Jack), the mystic (Simon), and the enforcer (Roger)—interacting with powerful symbolic motifs (the Conch of democratic order, the Signal Fire of hope, the Specs of reason, and the Beast). Antidote's flat-vector character rigs, dynamic symbolic metaphors, and kinetic typography are ideal for dramatizing ideological rupture and group psychology with supreme clarity without uncanny photorealism.
